card.name: Words just before 'nano' terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (using, the, that, a, held) in nanotechnology news text where the next word is likely to be 'nano' or 'nanoscale'. It also fires on words like silver or carbon in materials-science passages.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of 'nano' and 'nan' as the next word, so it seems to act as a brake on predicting those tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on ordinary words in nanotechnology articles just before the word nano would be expected.
